text: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, and those who are with him upon his religion are severe against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves; you see them bowing and prostrating to Allah in their prayer, hoping their Lord will bestow favor upon them, admit them to Paradise, and be pleased with them; the mark of their obedience to Allah is apparent on their faces from the trace of prostration and worship; this is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is like the description of a crop that brought forth its stalk and branch, then its branches multiplied after that, and strengthened the crop, so it became strong and stood upright on its stems, beautiful in appearance, pleasing the sowers; so that He may enrage the disbelievers by these believers in their multitude and beauty of appearance. And in this is evidence of disbelief for whoever hates the Companions—may Allah be pleased with them—; because whoever Allah enrages by the Companions, then what necessitates that has occurred in his case, which is disbelief. Allah has promised those among them who believed in Allah and His Messenger and did what Allah commanded them, and avoided what He forbade them, forgiveness of their sins and a great reward that does not cease, which is Paradise. And Allah's promise is true, confirmed, not broken, and whoever follows the path of the Companions—may Allah be pleased with them—is in their ruling regarding deserving forgiveness and the great reward, and they have the virtue, precedence, and perfection that no one from this nation can attain; may Allah be pleased with them and make them pleased.
